head: OUTBREAK DECK
say: Night shift at the Helix Research Facility. A storm has sealed the doors. Fifteen survivors are trapped inside. And some of them are not what they seem.

head: TRUST NO ONE
say: Outbreak Deck is a side view game of cards and lies. Six to fifteen players. Five to eight minute matches. Humans, against the hidden infected.

head: THE FACILITY
say: The facility is a cutaway of four floors and fifteen rooms, joined by doorways and ladders. Each room has its own colour. Only the room you stand in is lit. Everyone further away is a shadow.

head: THE SURVIVORS
say: Everyone wears the same hazmat suit. Your visor is your face. Happy, scared in a chase, suspicious when you call someone out. But it never shows what you really are.

head: YOUR SECRET ROLE
say: When the lights come on, you learn your role. Most of you are human. One, two or three are infected, and they know each other.

head: PLAY YOUR CARDS
say: Your hand is your weapon. Numbers one to nine, where higher wins. A human may carry a Gun with two bullets, or a Cure. The infected carry the Zombie card.

head: THE CHALLENGE
say: Walk up to anyone and challenge them. They can accept the duel, or run.

head: RUN!
say: Run, and the challenger has eight seconds to touch you. Ladders are your best friend.

head: THE DUEL
say: In a duel, you both pick one card in five seconds. The higher number wins. A Gun kills whoever it is played on. A Cure turns a zombie back. And the Zombie card bites. A bitten human turns on the spot, and nobody else is told.

head: HUNGER
say: But zombies get hungry. Sit on your Zombie card too long and you start to starve, growling and flaring green for everyone to see.

head: EMERGENCY MEETING
say: Something feels wrong? Slam the Emergency Button in the Central Hall. Thirty seconds to talk, fifteen to vote. Whoever gets the most votes goes to the Quarantine Cell, and their role stays a secret.

head: RESTORE THE POWER
say: Humans have a second way out. Find four generator parts, fit them in the Reactor, and an evac truck reaches the Entrance ninety seconds later.

head: BLACKOUT
say: The infected fight back. Once a match, the breaker in the Server Room plunges every human into darkness.

head: LAST STAND
say: Every ninety seconds, lightning lights every room and every silhouette. And when only one human is left, their Last Stand brings one bullet and five seconds of seeing every zombie.

head: WHO WINS?
sub: TEAM FIRST · THEN THE TOP PLAYER
say: Humans win by clearing every zombie, or by escaping. The infected win when no human is left. When the clock runs out, the bigger team takes it. And secret points crown one top player.

head: OUTBREAK DECK
sub: TRUST NO ONE · PLAY YOUR CARDS · SURVIVE
say: Trust no one. Play your cards. Survive the outbreak. Outbreak Deck.
